title: OpenAI Acquires Notch AI Team 3 Weeks After Startup Launch
summary:
Vinay Jain and Aman Jain are bringing their specialized tools for autonomous ad management to the advertising division of the company that develops ChatGPT. The founders of Notch will build agentic advertising products designed to help businesses scale growth autonomously, leveraging experience from working with thousands of small businesses to automate their ad budgets over the past two years.

The acquisition occurred just 3 weeks after the startup's official launch. Despite the brief public presence of the company, the founding team spent two years developing the technology and iterating its products before integrating into OpenAI's workforce.

selectedTweets.text:
Notch’s founding team is joining @OpenAI.

Two years ago, @ajain and I started Notch because we believed AI agents could help businesses grow autonomously. We built agentic experiences for advertising, worked with thousands of small businesses, and learned what it takes to turn fast-moving technology into something people use daily to run their ad budgets via Notch agents.

I’m proud of what our team built. They brought care to every iteration, and our customers made the work sharper. To our teammates, customers, investors, and everyone who backed us: thank you.

Aman and I are excited to bring what we’ve learned to the OpenAI Ads team.
